## Why the code is organised this way

There are two points about this script that are worth noting. The first is that the map does not show all of New York City. The code deliberately filters out Staten Island, which has very few fatal shootings but would otherwise occupy a large proportion of the map because it is so geographically large. Staten Island is excluded to make the map easier to read, particularly since readers of crime analysis products such as crime maps are usually (although not always) interested in the areas with _most_ crime.

The second feature is that the map legend has been moved inside the map area using various arguments to the `theme()` function. This means the legend doesn't take up space on the page/screen that can usefully be used to show the data. Look through the comments in the code to understand how this was done. The `theme()` function is very flexible and allows you to change the position of the legend, the size of the text, the background colour and many other features. You can also use `theme()` to change the appearance of other map elements such as the title, subtitle and caption.
